# TaxPri

> Cross-border tax orientation tool that helps cross-border workers between Slovenia and Italy, Croatia, and Austria understand their tax situation and what actions to take.

## Product overview

- [Homepage](https://taxpri.vercel.app/): Start your free analysis
- [How it works](https://taxpri.vercel.app/#how-it-works): Answer questions → rule-based analysis → get results and document checklist

## Supported scenarios

- [Italy-Slovenia cross-border work](https://taxpri.vercel.app/): Resident in Slovenia, employer in Italy
- [Croatia-Slovenia cross-border work](https://taxpri.vercel.app/): Resident in Slovenia, employer in Croatia
- [Austria-Slovenia cross-border work](https://taxpri.vercel.app/): Resident in Slovenia, employer in Austria (days and employer presence need verification)

## Important information

- This tool provides orientation only, not tax advice
- Results are based on rule-based analysis; specific cases require confirmation from a professional
